content:
General
* The contribution guidelines state that contributions must be written in English.

* There are already many clashes on palindromes. Please use another idea for your contribution.

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format and present your statement by following the example there.

Cases
* Every test and its validator should cover the same scenario, but with slightly different inputs and outputs.

Thanks.
Also, this contribution has binary output
